title: GistUI diagnostic
description: One report of a processor about a program (GistUI Format 1.0, section 22). The conformance suite writes code, severity, stmt, line and fixed.

stmt.description: Id of the statement concerned. A state declaration is written with its $.

fixed.description: True when the processor repaired the problem and the tree shows the repair. Left out otherwise.

hint.description: A signature or value list to show with the message.

use.description: The component name, enum value or child type the diagnostic is about or used instead.

arg.description: The argument concerned: a named key, or a positional index as text.

ref.description: The statement id a reference diagnostic is about.
